lidar.source: USGS NED 1/9 arc-second (about 3.4 m), NC statewide 2003 (ned19_n35x25_w079x50_nc_statewide_2003, public domain), from prd-tnm.s3.amazonaws.com; no 1 m DEM covers this pin. Resampled (bilinear) to a 1 m EPSG:26917 GeoTIFF, NED19_2003_pinehurst5_utm17_1m.tif, 2.4 km square round the pin. Flown before the 2010-11 restoration. Not in the repo
lidar.located_by: map pins from the project owner on the green (35.197038, -79.458473), placed at the game pin (37, 503), and on the tee (35.198610, -79.453982)

frame.why: tee -> pin is 444.5 m at 246.0 degrees (both pins from the project owner); the game's tee -> pin is 504 yd with the pin 37 yd left, so +z is 4.2 degrees right of that line and yd_per_m = 504 / 444.5. A 3.4 m DEM: heights and planes only; its hollows are not bunkers
